inbound_message:
From: Peter Lindqvist <p.lindqvist@mailbox.example>
To: Aerlink Customer Care <care@aerlink.example>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 12:02:55 +0100
Subject: Re: cancelled flight compensation claim BA-99201 - THIRD REQUEST

To whom it may concern,

I am writing for the third time about my cancelled flight, reference BA-99201,
on 29 July, Copenhagen to Manchester. I was delayed nine hours and I am claiming
the compensation I am entitled to under the regulations.

I have now written twice with no reply whatsoever. Please treat this as a formal
complaint about both the original flight and your failure to respond, and confirm
in writing within 14 days.

Yours faithfully,
Peter Lindqvist
